title: SKE Crystal Plus Red Apple Ice Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Red Apple Ice flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods deliver the classic crisp and refreshing taste of sweet, juicy red apple, perfectly balanced with a cool, frosty icy finish. This classic combination of fruity sweetness and an icy exhale makes Red Apple Ice an ideal choice for vapers who love clean, vibrant, and classic flavours. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods are a hassle-free solution for vapers seeking a smooth and satisfying MTL (Mouth-To-Lung) experience. The pods feature the same eye-catching crystalline design as the original SKE Crystal Bar disposables, providing a more sustainable and convenient alternative. Each prefilled pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to freebase nicotine. Thanks to the integrated 1.1ohm mesh coil, these pods ensure excellent flavour production and a consistent, satisfying vape with every puff. With their user-friendly design, SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods eliminate the need for messy refills or coil changes – simply replace the pod when it’s empty, and you’re ready to enjoy the next flavour. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
